name: Raging Haftbell
description: Chop at the seam between two plates of armor where the steel is thinnest.

name: Blazetimber
description: Chop into chain mail and pull back sharply to tear rings apart across the wound.

name: Gust Wideswell
description: Step heavily to the side of an armored foe whose turn is slower than the axe.

name: Remnant Greatbeard
description: Read the slit of a visor to judge where the armored foe is looking and where they are blind.

name: Facetgreat
description: Cleave onto one plate with qi packed at the edge until the plate splits along its seam.

name: Cleaving Longhelve
description: Hook the beard under the gorget and cut upward into the throat guard with qi at the toe.

name: Glint Greatbit
description: Drive qi through the whole length of the bit and cleave straight through plate and the body beneath.

name: Tearing Doubleedge
description: Fall onto the shoulder of an armored foe with a qi-hardened edge that splits mail and bone.

name: Rumblerend
description: Chop from a stance planted so firmly that the legs give the stroke all its backing.

name: Irongreat
description: Sink the body into the ground and hold the haft braced against a heavy impact.

name: Chime Greatpoll
description: Feel each foot press the ground to keep the stance true while the opponent circles.

name: Might Rend
description: Shuffle the feet back into the set stance after any swing has pulled them out of position.

name: Rumble Heavyeye
description: Chop from the rooted stance with qi sunk to the heels so the full body drives the blow.

name: Equipoise Greatbit
description: Meet an advancing blow with the haft and turn it so the attacker's own stance is broken.

name: Intent Hewfall
description: Swing the head across the front repeatedly from a rooted stance to keep every foe out of reach.

name: Sundertorment
description: Lock the stance with qi and cleave with all of the body's weight and none of its motion.

name: Scorching Riven
description: Hammer the head down from a fixed stance with qi so dense that the blow crushes guards.

name: Gustsunder
description: Chop in a ring around the body so that anyone stepping close is in the path.

name: Silt Haftrope
description: Step across open ground to keep every foe on one side of the axe.

name: Aegistimber
description: Hold the axe level in front to keep a clear space around the body.

name: Remnant Longhelve
description: Watch the edge of the crowd of foes to find which of them will close in first.

name: Rupturing Splitmass
description: Spin the great bit in a wide ring with qi so that every foe near the wielder is cut.

name: Vaulting Sunder
description: Move in a slow circle with qi lightening the feet so foes are kept spread around the axe.

name: Lancing Overhew
description: Sweep the greataxe across a full half-circle with qi along the edge and cut down all who stand within reach.

name: Lambasting Wideswell
description: Keep the great bit whirling around the body with qi so that anyone closing the ring is struck.

name: Timbertorment
description: Breathe the qi field out along the haft and chop so the cut reaches a little past the edge.

name: Rumble Greatbeard
description: Time a sharp exhale to the impact so the qi field hardens around the bit at contact.

name: Torrent Rend
description: Step on a pulse of breath and let the qi field carry the body the extra distance.

name: Remnant Doubleedge
description: Read the opponent's body at the edge of the qi field to see where their blow will start.

name: Iron Riven
description: Cleave while the field feeds qi to the edge on every breath so the cut stays sharp.

name: Intentaxe
description: Pulse qi from the field along the haft to add weight and speed to the next strokes.

name: Ironaxe
description: Wrap the haft in the qi field with a held breath and stop a blow that would break wood.

name: Granite Heavyeye
description: Extend the qi field past the edge and cleave so the force lands before the steel does.

name: Skinning Splitmass
description: Gather the field in the bit for a held breath and release it in a single cleave that outreaches the blade.

name: Sanguine Poleshoe
description: Let the edge fall in a plain chop while qi is still gathering in the haft.

name: Tempered Poleshoe
description: Push down on the haft with a pulse of qi at the moment the head begins its fall.

name: Timberleap
description: Pace the footwork so that the body arrives in range exactly as the edge begins to fall.

name: Thorn Haftrope
description: Stand behind the falling edge so the head and haft together screen the body.

name: Remnant Haftbell
description: Read how the opponent will react to the fall of the head before the blow is released.

name: Mightaxe
description: Drive qi through the haft into the falling head so it descends faster than a swung chop.

name: Blaze Hewfall
description: Hold a second pulse of qi behind the first and release it as the first blow lands.

name: Chimeaxe
description: Stop the fall of the head mid-stroke with qi in the haft and turn aside an incoming blow.

name: Irontimber
description: Stack successive pulses of qi in the haft behind a single falling edge and land them at once.

name: Blazerend
description: Push qi into the fall at the top and again at the midpoint so the edge accelerates twice.

name: Gust Greatpoll
description: Chop along one track while the feet follow the second so the cut and the step stay paired.

name: Poleshoe Jaunt
description: Step onto the second track just as the first stroke lands and be ready to cut again.

name: Chime Greatbit
description: Hold the haft across both tracks and turn aside a strike with the near hand and the far hand together.

name: Rousing Greatpoll
description: Read both of the opponent's lines of attack at once and note which one is feint.

name: Sanguine Rend
description: Hew along both tracks in two beats with qi carried from the first beat into the second.

name: Hewfall Onslaught
description: Swap from one track to the other mid-swing with a turn of the wrists and cut from the new side.

name: Rivenbarrage
description: Press down on the opponent's weapon with the head while stepping onto the second track to pin it.

name: Rendassault
description: Cleave down one track and across the other in one breath with qi riding both strokes.

name: Raging Might Splitmass
description: Drop the head with qi pressed into both tracks so the single blow lands with a doubled weight.

name: Iron Doubleedge
description: Open with a short chop whose only purpose is to draw out the opponent's reply.

name: Overhew Onslaught
description: Follow the opening chop with a long cut aimed at the gap the reply has opened.

name: Sunderleap
description: Take two linked steps through the opponent's line so the second step starts the second cut.

name: Fortifying Heavyeye
description: Count the opponent's strokes in twos to learn when their pair will end and a gap will open.

name: Rumble Sunder
description: Answer a blow with the great bit and cut again with the haft end before qi can fade.

name: Unflinching Longhelve
description: Turn aside an attack with the head and strike back with the same motion in a paired return.

name: Ironrend
description: Cleave from the left and then from the right in matched strokes that meet at the target.

name: Blaze Riven
description: Fall twice upon the same point with qi doubled in the second stroke to crush the guard.

name: Chimegreat
description: Rise on the toes with the axe held high and survey the field from a hawk's height.

name: Might Haftrope
description: Drop from the raised stance into a falling chop aimed at the opponent's crown.

name: Torrent Haftbell
description: Spread the arms like wings and step in a long arc to come at the foe from above.

name: Staunch Wideswell
description: Hold the haft against the sky line to catch a blow that comes from the high ground.

name: Thorn Greatbeard
description: Hold the axe raised with qi in the shoulders so a descending attack is stopped before it lands.

name: Sanguine Greatpoll
description: Fall from the raised hold and strike with qi gathered in the arms and the leading shoulder.

name: Axegreave
description: Catch the opponent's weapon in the beard like a talon and pull it down to the ground.

name: Iron Sunder
description: Rise high and fall in one drive with all the field's qi poured into a single descending cleave.

name: Cleaving Might Hewfall
description: Hold the axe at the peak of the rise while qi builds and then plunge through the opponent's guard.

name: Severing Overhew
description: Chop smoothly with no pause at the top so the stroke runs like water over a weir.

name: Soaring Haftbell
description: Step along the line of the opponent's motion as a swimmer moves with a current.

name: Gustgreat
description: Turn the head in a small circle before the body so a blow is caught and swirled aside.

name: Timberlinctus
description: Read where the opponent's line of attack bends and where its force will pool.

name: Iron Greatbit
description: Cut at the lip of the opponent's stance so that their balance spills from their feet.

name: Blaze Greatbeard
description: Chain cleaves smoothly so that each stroke empties into the next along the qi field.

name: Compressing Poleshoe
description: Hook the beard in the opponent's guard and draw them along like a boat on a rope.

name: Gusttimber
description: Spin the head in an eddy around an incoming strike and send its force into the ground.

name: Drubbing Splitmass
description: Pour the whole of the qi field through one long cleave that runs the length of the target.

name: Dismantling Haftrope
description: Sweep the axe in a flooding arc so that the qi field cuts down foes across the whole front.

name: Splitting Doubleedge
description: Chop with the wind at the back so that the head falls faster than the arms alone could drive it.

name: Rendleap
description: Step with a gust at the heels and cover a long stride in one beat.

name: Longhelve Cloak
description: Hold the haft as a sworn line that no blow is allowed to cross.

name: Greatlinctus
description: Feel the draft of the opponent's swing against the skin before the blow arrives.

name: Tempered Overhew
description: Cut with qi borrowing the wind's speed so that the great bit crosses the gap before a guard.

name: Ravaging Rend
description: Hew down like a branch torn loose by the wind with qi pressed along the whole edge.

name: Rumble Riven
description: Swear the stroke to the wind and let it carry the greataxe through the opponent's guard.

name: Drubbing Heavyeye
description: Fall onto the foe with the full weight of the wind and the oath held behind the head.

name: Cleaving Wideswell
description: Chop from a stance at the very edge of the ground with the drop at the heels.

name: Granite Splitmass
description: Step sure-footed along the cliff lip so that the foe has to give ground first.

name: Unyielding Greatpoll
description: Guard the front with the haft while the open air behind the body keeps every foe in view.

name: Axeremedy
description: Read the wind rising off the drop to tell where the opponent is leaning.

name: Tempered Doubleedge
description: Cleave from the edge of the ground with qi in the legs so that the stance cannot be pushed back.

name: Staunch Greatbit
description: Turn aside a charge with the haft and a pulse of qi while nothing stands behind the body.

name: Drubbing Greatbeard
description: Press the opponent back toward the drop with a series of heavy chops that give no room.

name: Sanguine Riven
description: Hew with the full qi field from the plateau edge and hold the line against any rush.

name: Furrowing Haftrope
description: Cleave with nothing behind the wielder and all of the field's qi forward in the blade.

name: Sanguine Hewfall
description: Chop along one chosen line and keep every following stroke on it.

name: Might Sunder
description: Take a step that fixes the bearing of the axe on the foe and then stay on it.

name: Haftbell Plating
description: Hold the haft along the sworn line and refuse to be moved off it by any push.

name: Verityaxe
description: Check the bearing against the foe's motion and note when it drifts from the line.

name: Rumble Overhew
description: Cut with the bearing unchanged so that the edge arrives exactly where it was aimed.

name: Might Longhelve
description: Hew along the held bearing with qi that shrugs off the foe's attempts to turn the stroke.

name: Murk Poleshoe
description: Meet an attack on the sworn line and turn it by pressing qi through the haft.

name: Mayhem Heavyeye
description: Pull the opponent's weapon down along the line with the beard and hold it there.

name: Granite Hewfall
description: Hew along the sworn bearing with the full qi field and let nothing alter the course of the stroke.

name: Drubbing Wideswell
description: Fall along a bearing that cannot be turned and bring the head down through the foe's guard.

name: Blaze Greatbit
description: Fix the gaze on the foe's centerline and chop straight down that line.

name: Silt Poleshoe
description: Step into a gale at the back and let it push the body forward into the stroke.

name: Unyielding Haftbell
description: Hold the haft before the body so the oncoming wind seems to harden against a blow.

name: Renewing Heavyeye
description: Feel the gale's bend around the foe and take a bearing from the way it shifts.

name: Needling Rend
description: Cut with the gale carrying the head so that qi need only guide the edge.

name: Downpour Doubleedge
description: Cross the bearing with a wide sweep that catches foes on either side of the line.

name: Timberbarrage
description: Let the gale lift and drive the greataxe in a long stroke with qi holding it on its bearing.

name: Sunder Maelstrom
description: Hold the bearing and cleave straight through a defended line as the gale presses the head forward.
